featured_reviews.name: Himanshi Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
I don’t usually write long reviews, but this team deserves every word. I have never experienced this level of ease and peace of mind with any team that feels like family, before. Dhruv and Sourabh led an absolutely amazing team-experienced, prepared, and so deeply tuned in to every moment that mattered.

They didn’t just take photos; they made sure we lived our moments too. They would literally push my parents to step out of their Marwadi hospitality mode and actually enjoy their own celebration. They guided my CA couple to pose (which is honestly a task in itself!), and they did it with so much patience, warmth, and humour.

What touched me the most was how invested they were. I would have to force them to go eat because they were so focused on capturing everything perfectly. From late nights to early mornings, they showed up with the same energy, the same dedication, and the same big-hearted enthusiasm.

Their work ethic, their vibe, their passion — everything is admirable. My entire family is genuinely grateful that they were part of our celebration. They didn’t just capture our memories… they became a beautiful part of them.

Highly, highly recommended.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a professional photography setup! 📸✨

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Khire
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely unprofessional behavior. They don’t pick up calls during normal business hours and claim they are out of town and only available via text, yet reply on Sunday saying it’s their holiday. They quoted Rs. 12L for a 3-day event including photography and a wedding film, but when I asked what the videography actually includes (short reel, documentary, trailer, etc.), the only response was, “Yes, videography is included.” That level of communication is unacceptable for a service at this price point.

When I raised concerns, they asked for my email to send details even though a PDF could easily be shared on WhatsApp. Only after I said I cannot manage such important discussions over text did they agree to a phone call, and even then the tone felt like they were doing me a favor while on holiday. If you’re on holiday, don’t respond. I’ve dealt with far more reputed and well-known vendors who communicate far more professionally.

featured_reviews.name: Ashay Vyavaharkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We were planning a senior management photoshoot and came across CineFoto Studio in Dadar. I connected with Mr. Chintu, the owner and photographer, who was extremely professional, understood our requirements well, and offered the best deal compared to others.

The studio itself is state-of-the-art, spick & span, and equipped with everything you’d need for a smooth shoot. On the day of the shoot, one of our directors couldn’t make it, and we had to cancel last minute. Chintu, being a thorough gentleman, didn’t charge us a single rupee and was very understanding of the situation.

If you’re looking for a reliable photographer or a well-equipped studio in Dadar (or beyond), I’d highly recommend Chintu at CineFoto Studio.
